<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="continueGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->

  <rect x="24" y="94" width="342" height="5" rx="3" fill="#EAEDF1"/>

  <text x="366" y="119" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">3 OF 5</text>

  <!-- Heading -->
  <text x="24" y="166" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">I am a</text>
  <text x="24" y="192" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the option that feels right for you.</text>

  <!-- Woman option -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="222" width="342" height="70" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="57" cy="257" r="16" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="252" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="57" y1="257" x2="57" y2="269" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>

  <line x1="57" y1="269" x2="52" y2="276" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <rect x="24" y="306" width="342" height="70" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>

  <line x1="57" y1="353" x2="52" y2="360" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="57" y1="353" x2="62" y2="360" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="88" y="347" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Man</text>

    <rect x="24" y="390" width="342" height="70" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <circle cx="51" cy="425" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="425" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="425" r="2" fill="#939393"/>

  <circle cx="340" cy="425" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <polyline points="334,529 338,533 346,524" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="24" y="584" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can change this anytime in Settings.</text>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">

  </g>
  <text x="195" y="656" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>

    <text x="123" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <polygon points="195,795 198,802 206,803 200,808 202,816 195,811 188,816 190,808 184,803 192,802" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="195" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="255" y="796" width="22" height="16" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="260,812 258,817 265,812" fill="#939393"/>

    <circle cx="270" cy="804" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="266" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">CHAT</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="340" cy="800" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="340" cy="814" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="340" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
</svg>
